verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI offers persistent project context via GEMINI.md and conversation checkpointing to resume sessions, which could serve as a form of cross-session memory, but this is manually authored/saved rather than automatically built and recalled by the agent. Hands-on reports directly contradict reliable memory recall, noting the CLI 'consistently ignores my GEMINI.md file... even though it's always saying that 1 GEMINI.md file is being used... it hallucinates wildly.' Missing for 10: an actual automatic memory-building/recall feature (vs. static config files and manual checkpoints), and independent confirmation that context persists reliably across sessions.
